description: Character catalog for a future showcase site. The formula is the damage rule. n is the bounce count. Math results cap at 1e21.
source: ORB_RACERS, CLASSIC_ORBS, and the racer-card damage rules.

modes.orb-race: The team that clears every one of its own layers first wins. The opponent's remaining health does not decide the race.

characters.name: Duplicator
characters.formula: Starts at 1, +1 per bounce, and copies itself

characters.name: Speedster
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, and speed ramps on each bounce

characters.name: Orbital
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, plus orbiter contacts on the line

characters.name: Drill
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, plus drill projectiles

characters.name: X²
characters.formula: n² on bounce n

characters.name: Fibonacci
characters.formula: The nth Fibonacci number

characters.name: Sylvester
characters.formula: Sylvester sequence: 2, then v(v−1)+1

characters.name: Lucas Sequence
characters.formula: Lucas number Lₙ. First hit is 1

characters.name: Tetration
characters.formula: Base-2 tetration. 2, 4, 16, 65536

characters.name: Professor
characters.formula: The copied math formula. 0 while no form is active

characters.name: Trifecta
characters.formula: Body 0. Every 3rd hit removes 1/3 of that layer’s original maximum

characters.name: Gravitator
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, then attaches and pulls the layer

characters.name: Grower
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, and the body grows

characters.name: Lazer
characters.formula: Body stays 1. The beam hits faster after every bounce

characters.name: Sticky
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, plus ground ticks while stuck

characters.name: Unarmed
characters.formula: +1 damage and a speed ramp per bounce

characters.name: Piercer
characters.formula: +0.75 per number-line hit, and the hit pierces layers

characters.name: Ying Yang
characters.formula: Switches speed and damage modes. Damage level rises in damage mode

characters.name: Poison
characters.formula: Body 0. Ticks grow by 1 each bounce and pulse every 0.1s

characters.name: Hydrogen Bomb
characters.formula: Body 0. After 60 seconds every layer is set to 0 and the other team is destroyed

characters.name: Antimatter Bomb
characters.formula: Body 0 until detonation. The fuse shortens from 15s toward 5s

characters.name: Time Bomb
characters.formula: Body 0 until the midnight blast

characters.name: Reality Bomb
characters.formula: Body 0. Summoned Slammies deal 1 + 2n

characters.name: Tsar Bomb
characters.formula: Body 0. A 90-second fuse, then a reactor-scale blast

characters.name: All In One
characters.formula: Body damage × the active-window power. Power rises 10× per bounce while active

characters.name: Breaker
characters.formula: Body is 1. A crit removes half the layer’s original max, plus 1

characters.name: Square Root
characters.formula: Removes health − √health, so the layer is left at its root

characters.name: Progressive
characters.formula: A timer damage that starts at 1 and climbs

characters.name: Random
characters.formula: A seeded roll from 1 to a maximum that grows every bounce

characters.name: Lag
characters.formula: Body 0. The glitch channel deals the damage

characters.name: Twins
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, shared with the twin

characters.name: Scissor
characters.formula: Body 0. The split pieces deal the damage

characters.name: Whirlwind
characters.formula: Body 0. Damage comes from contacts along the line

characters.name: RGB
characters.formula: 1 plus a color-mode bonus, and the body grows

characters.name: Xˣ
characters.formula: nⁿ on bounce n

characters.name: Super X^X
characters.formula: n^(nⁿ), inner exponent capped at 16

characters.name: Golden Ratio
characters.formula: round(φⁿ), φ = (1+√5)/2

characters.name: Factorial
characters.formula: n!

characters.name: Prime
characters.formula: The nth prime

characters.name: Quadratic
characters.formula: 2ⁿ

characters.name: Pi
characters.formula: Running damage × the next digit of pi

characters.name: Flash
characters.formula: +1 per bounce. A full charge makes the next ramp 5×

characters.name: Batman
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, plus batarangs

characters.name: Boomerang
characters.formula: Projectile damage equals the bounce count

characters.name: Magnet
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, and it pulls nearby orbs

characters.name: Splodey
characters.formula: Thrown bombs deal the current bounce count

characters.name: Gravity
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, and gravity level rises

characters.name: Jackpot
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, plus the slot result

characters.name: Slow
characters.formula: Starts at 50, then +100 per bounce

characters.name: Ricochet Cannon
characters.formula: +1 per bounce. Every 3rd bounce fires a shot that doubles off walls

characters.name: Commander
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, plus drone bombs and missiles

characters.name: Shrapnel
characters.formula: +1 per bounce. A broken layer throws fragments

characters.name: Absorber
characters.formula: Copies another orb’s ability on a timer, then uses that ability’s damage

characters.name: Architect
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, plus what it builds

characters.name: Sawblade
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, plus saw shots

characters.name: Meteor
characters.formula: +1 per bounce. Meteors scale off that damage

characters.name: Black Hole
characters.formula: Hits stay at 1 until the singularity returns the drained total

characters.name: Godzilla
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, plus stomp, swipe, and the beam while firing

characters.name: Centy
characters.formula: Layer max × percent. Starts at 1%, +0.1% per bounce

characters.name: Infinity
characters.formula: 1×10²¹ on every hit

characters.name: Charger
characters.formula: +1 per bounce. The charge interval shrinks

characters.name: Bouncer
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, plus the mini orbs’ own hits

characters.name: Blue Sun
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, plus lasers that hit the line

characters.name: Purple Sun
characters.formula: Beams by power level. Body does not take the +1 ramp

characters.name: The Sun
characters.formula: Body 0. Damage is the phase-three beam

characters.name: Phase Two Sun
characters.formula: Body 0. Damage is the phase-two beam

characters.name: Snake
characters.formula: Body 0. The grounded tail deals the damage

characters.name: Vampire
characters.formula: Steal percent rises every bounce and is taken from the hit

characters.name: Cubed
characters.formula: n³

characters.name: Double
characters.formula: 2ⁿ

characters.name: Tripler
characters.formula: 3ⁿ

characters.name: Turret
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, plus turret shots

characters.name: Leech
characters.formula: +1 per bounce. Leech level follows the sticky hold

characters.name: Crusher
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, plus extra damage as weight rises

characters.name: Berserker
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, and more while trailing by 10% of the layer

characters.name: Reactor
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, plus the charged blast

characters.name: Parasite
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, plus each attached parasite

characters.name: Draftmaster
characters.formula: +1 per bounce, plus drafted bullets

characters.name: Needle
characters.formula: Pierce hits. The body does not take the +1 ramp

characters.name: Multiplier
characters.formula: Scales the hit by its multiplier instead of +1 per bounce

characters.name: Sniper
characters.formula: Shot damage. Bounce shortens the fire cooldown

characters.name: Snowball
characters.formula: Grows, and the hit is not the plain +1 ramp

characters.name: Countdown
characters.formula: A blast multiplier when the countdown lands

characters.name: Copycat
characters.formula: Body starts at 0, then uses the damage of the orb it copied

characters.name: Critical
characters.formula: A critical multiplier on the hit, off the +1 ramp

characters.name: Grappler
characters.formula: Body starts at 0. The grapple supplies the hit

characters.name: Artist
characters.formula: Body starts at 0. Painting damage rises when scaling is on

characters.name: Pancake
characters.formula: +1 per bounce. Syrup and butter patches tick on the layer

characters.name: Tree
characters.formula: +1 per bounce. After the charge, roots drain every layer

characters.name: Rain
characters.formula: Body 0. Rain hits the layer

characters.name: Hacker
characters.formula: Body 0. Each hack applies one seeded outcome

characters.name: Miner
characters.formula: Body 0. The drill eats the current layer by progress

characters.name: Sword
characters.formula: Swing 5. Extended poke 3. Last team alive wins

characters.name: Tripwire
characters.formula: Permanent wall wires, 1 damage per second

characters.name: Necromancer
characters.formula: Two 1 HP soldiers. Arrows deal 3

characters.name: Spikey
characters.formula: Permanent wall spikes, 3 damage

characters.name: Virus
characters.formula: Contact stack 1, then 2, then onward, in 5-second windows

characters.name: Cobwebs
characters.formula: Webs deal 1 damage per second

characters.name: Apple
characters.formula: Every 2s: owner +3 HP, opponent −5 HP

characters.name: Classic Absorber
characters.formula: Absorbs one seeded opponent ability

characters.name: Cowboy
characters.formula: Three lassos, 4 damage per second

characters.name: Hive Ball
characters.formula: Bees deal 3 per hit

characters.name: Zeus
characters.formula: Lightning, 10 damage per second

characters.name: Glass Ball
characters.formula: 3 to 5 shards, 2 damage each

characters.name: Pistol
characters.formula: Two shots, 5 damage

characters.name: Shotgun
characters.formula: Wide spread, 4 damage

characters.name: Rifle
characters.formula: Five rounds, two wall ricochets

characters.name: Sawball
characters.formula: Twin saws, 5 damage

characters.name: Cutter
characters.formula: 2 damage every 0.5s inside the red zone

characters.name: Trident
characters.formula: Throw deals 20 and sticks for 3 seconds

characters.name: Parasites
characters.formula: A latch deals 2 damage per second

characters.name: Train
characters.formula: After three wall bounces, the train deals 10

characters.name: Classic Snowball
characters.formula: Frost trail deals 3 on entry and can freeze

characters.name: Boxer
characters.formula: A punch cycle: retract, extend, impact, recover

characters.name: Classic Artist
characters.formula: Summons Monster, Fairy, or Soldier

characters.name: Monster
characters.formula: Fists deal 5

characters.name: Fairy
characters.formula: Tracking wand magic
